decisions.reason: Shop relaunch SEO support builds directly on the firm's core relaunch, shop development and search marketing expertise across many shops, so it can interpret results and refine the service with knowledge it already holds, and it has been presented steadily on its own page for two years.

SEO workshops apply the firm's existing certified marketing know-how in a new teaching format with low cost, and the firm can read client feedback through its established consulting relationships, although being newly launched in 2024 makes it somewhat less certain than the relaunch service.
